Title: Beyonder Clan
ChangeLog:
Version 0.9.10: 

 * 'Phleghmbuyouancy' has new art. 

 * 'Coping Mechanism' rarity changed to uncommon.

 * 'StonedStone' now adds 'Draw +1 next turn,' in addition to Therapeutic.

 * New artifact added: [Hellborne Pathogens] 'Helleopathic Remedy' (DLC required). Friendly units no longer attack. Instead, they increase spell power on their floor by [attack] x Hits + [health].

 [bug fix] Removed Cave of a Thousand Eyes from the 'All Units' banner pool. This prevents it from appearing in card draft rewards outside of the cavern event.

 * [Succubus] Scourge Magnet artifact redesigned. It now instantly draws Blight and Scourge cards when they're added to your deck and makes them no longer discard (same effect as Frozen).

 * Capped the RunHistory.json file at the 1000 most recent entries.

 [Bug Fix] Fixed a bug associated with re-rolling champion upgrade paths. The new versions will now properly overwrite the previous ones.

 * Improved functionality for locating missing Essence data in run summaries. This only applies to run summaries where the original Beyonder run history data is missing.
